title: Tenant Isolation
summary: Hard boundaries so one customer cannot read/write another's data.
explain: Multi-tenant SaaS must enforce tenant context on every query and admin API. Shared schemas need discriminators plus mandatory filters; better designs add defense in depth. Overbroad support roles and missing guards create cross-tenant incidents — treat as Sev-1 security.
analogy: Hotel master keys should not open every safe; staff tools need scoped access and audit.
mnemonic: HOTEL WALLS: Tenant walls are load-bearing — not curtains (UI filters).
useCases: Greenfield design workshop: decide if “Tenant Isolation” is required given constraints (latency, clean-core, team skills).
Multi-tenant SaaS demo: Tenant B token must not read Tenant A orders — prove Tenant Isolation.
Architecture review board: defend why you accepted residual risk around “Tenant Isolation”.
